items.title: Tractor Supply Loses Top Executive

items.title: Tractor Supply (TSCO) Looks Fully Valued On Petsense Instacart Delivery Deal
items.summary: Tractor Supply (TSCO) is back in focus after its Petsense chain signed an exclusive same day delivery partnership with Instacart, placing more than 130 stores on the grocery tech company’s platform. For investors, the Petsense Instacart deal lands at a time when Tractor Supply’s share price has gained 14.1% over the past 30 days and 15.4% over 90 days, while the year-to-date share price return is down 30.4% and the 1-year total shareholder return has declined 41.3%. items.title: Instacart becomes exclusive delivery partner for pet retailer Petsense
items.summary: The arrangement lets shoppers browse and order from Petsense's inventory via the Instacart app or site, with delivery windows as short as one hour in some areas.

items.title: Is Tractor Supply Company (TSCO) an Underrated Dividend Growth Opportunity?

The company has increased its dividend for 17 straight years, including a 4.3% increase in 2026 to $0.96 per share annually, or $0.24 per quarter. items.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 We Approach with Caution
items.summary: Stocks trading between $10 and $50 can be particularly interesting as they frequently represent businesses that have survived their early challenges. However, investors should remain vigilant as some may still have unproven business models, leaving them vulnerable to the ebbs and flows of the broader market.
